problem: Receipt admission deserializes and discards a complete response only to distinguish null and a root object whose final ok field equals false. Prior escaped workload observer identified about 0.99 ms here; allocations versus lexing needed separation.
implementation: Private non-materializing root classifier uses the original CheckedJson traversal for ordinary child fields. Root null and final duplicate ok:false suppress receipts; all fields parsed; first reserved Serde marker in any map retains Value fallback. Malformed JSON preserves the old conservative true behavior. Existing validate implementation and proof/deadline/worker/receipt identity paths are unchanged.

gates.scope: Library checks pass across the full run and isolated corrected catalog recompile. All integration targets pass together. No assertion that the earlier full command exited zero.

default_off_writes.scope: Strict native production SDK on disposable local xfs. Timed latency excludes content generation; timed process CPU and phase wall include content generation. RSS is cumulative process high-water across shapes, not per-case native heap. Per-leg P99 has 200 samples and cannot certify tail dominance. Fresh processes, shared host; no performance credit for compile-overlapped driver validation.

default_off_point_read_control.scope: Fresh process/authority SDK point reads; every complete response equals independently checked reference. CPU includes comparison and loop bookkeeping. P99 mean is a mean of per-leg summaries, not pooled.

observer.scope: Separate sequential profiled roles, four fresh handles each, 25 append commands per shape including warmup. No dropped samples, invalid spans or ledger mismatch. Perturbed wall spans only, no comparative CPU/performance credit.
observer.finding: Escaped policy stays 981.64 -> 968.076 microseconds per command: removing Value materialization leaves almost all lexical/unescape cost. Repetitive large policy 60.153 -> 46.157 us, unique 60.356 -> 47.301 us; end-to-end mixed regressions defeat adopting that local win.

actual_sdk_replay.scope: For repetitive/unique/escaped 256 KiB payloads in each role: initial execution, immediate repeat and graceful reopen repeat return equal complete semantic values; first committed-events carrier is validated/unwrapped according to the application command contract. Divergent same-command reuse rejects with database_conflict and the stored original content remains exact. Not process-SIGKILL certification.

next_root_target.decision: Carry receipt policy evidence from actual response production through selected IR result, rather than replacing one full JSON parser with another.
requirements: Proof binds actual immutable encoded allocation and actual selected response, never an operation-name whitelist.
Mutable slot access/result replacement must invalidate the proof; raw literals, unknown markers and serialized receipt replay retain the old fallback.
Null/final duplicate ok:false and malformed-input true behavior stay exact. Serde root markers and ok values that reinterpret through RawValue need explicit unknown fallback.
Receipt policy is not the final integrity validator: old parse errors already return true; final semantic response validation must remain intact.
No receipt content/digest/replay, owner/CAS, watchdog, deadline, durability or memory-budget changes; same-source end-to-end and read controls decide acceptance.
